To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the direction and distance of nucleosome sliding can be controlled by how the chromatin remodeling enzyme is targeted to DNA.
targeting Chd1 to nucleosomes via DNA versus histones alters the properties of this remodeler.

the Chd1 remodeler can be targeted to chromatin by either DNA or histones, and that the mechanism of nucleosome sliding depends on the method of recruitment, which in turn determines the outcome of nucleosomal sliding.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which chromatin remodelers can organize or disrupt chromatin structure and how this is influenced by the nature of the remodeler–nucleosome interaction.
the mechanism of chromatin remodeling and how the remodeler Chd1 is able to move along the DNA.
the mechanisms of nucleosome remodeling by Chd1 and how the remodeler can be targeted to chromatin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Chd1 is a chromatin remodelers that can act in either a SWI/SNF or ISWI-like fashion depending on how the protein is targeted to nucleosomal DNA.
the mechanism of Chd1 nucleosome sliding is dependent on the nature of the nucleosome recognition site.
the outcome of Chd1 nucleosome sliding is determined by how the remodeler is targeted and not by the DNA-binding properties of Chd1 itself.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
nucleosome recognition and DNA binding are separable activities of the Chd family remodelers and that these activities can have opposing effects on nucleosome positioning.

nucleosome sliding by the Chd1 remodeler can be directed in a DNA sequence-specific manner, but the ability to slide nucleosomes off DNA is dependent on the remodeler being targeted to nucleosomes via the histone octamer.
the Chd1 remodeler is able to disrupt nucleosome arrays, but only when the remodeler is targeted by biotinylating histones, and not by biotin labeling of DNA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the outcome of chromatin remodeling can be controlled by altering how the remodeler is recruited to chromatin.
chromatin remodeler properties are not intrinsic to the remodeler itself, but are determined by the way in which the remodeler interacts with nucleosomes.
the outcome of chromatin remodelling can be controlled by the means of recruitment of the remodelers to chromatin.
